attorneys.name: Robin J Wright
attorneys.practice_type: High Asset Divorce Lawyers in Portland, OR
attorneys.bio:
No two family law matters are the same. Some are relatively simple, others quite complicated. Some focus on children, others on finances. Often the focus is on both. Regardless, it's important to figure out the client's priorities and help them work toward these goals. Robin's experience in juvenile court and criminal law enable her to bring creativity and insight into family law cases that fall outside the standard family law box. She works hard to educate clients about their options, then move forward with the client's goals foremost in mind. A calm but dogged advocate, Robin is comfortable resolving cases both in and out of the courtroom. Robin understands the legal and practical choices clients must make and that education and thorough preparation can help reduce the stress that often accompanies family and juvenile law cases.

When not helping clients, Robin enjoys spending time with her family, including her two grown children. Passionate about following politics and current events, Robin also follows her husband literally as the stoker on their tandem bicycle (one way to be sure she keeps up with him!). She also loves the creative challenge of pulling in fresh ingredients to cook with from whatever is in season in her garden.

attorneys.name: Valerie Wright
attorneys.practice_type: Criminal Law Lawyers in Bend, OR
attorneys.bio:
Valerie Wright is a trial attorney who received her education at Harvard University and the University of Denver College of Law. She believes in listening carefully to the person who needs her services in order to accomplish the goals that the client sets. She is known for striking an excellent balance between idealistic and realistic, between principle and compromise, between the past action and the future possibility. Valerie specializes in criminal and juvenile law, with an emphasis on defending allegations of sexual abuse.

She believes that it is critical to have top-notch trial skills and an excellent command of the rules of evidence in order to get good results in the courtroom. Furthermore, her experience in the criminal law arena (27 years) gives her the credibility and respect necessary to resolve many cases without the need for going to trial.

When not working, Valerie enjoys spending time with her husband, son and dogs and she can often be found hiking the many trails found in the mountains and plateaus of the high Desert in central and eastern Oregon.

attorneys.practice_type: High Asset Divorce Lawyers in Portland, OR
attorneys.bio:
With nearly 40 years of experience, Michael Yates is recognized as one of Oregon’s preeminent family law attorneys. He has been included in the annual editions of The Best Lawyers in America since 2003, and is consistently named as an "Oregon Super Lawyer", a recognition of the top 5% of practicing Oregon attorneys, as determined by a rigorous peer review process. Michael was recently named in the 2024 Edition of Oregon Super Lawyers Top 10. Michael was also named the Best Lawyers' 2011 and 2016 Portland, OR Family Lawyer of the Year. The Lawyer of the Year award is an extremely prestigious honor named to only one lawyer per practice area within each metropolitan region, based on the highest peer ratings received. In 2016, Michael received the Oregon State Bar Family Law Section’s Professionalism Award. He maintains an AV® Preeminent rating from Martindale-Hubbell - the highest possible rating in both legal ability and ethical standards.

Michael obtained his undergraduate degree summa cum laude from Kent State University, and graduated from The Ohio State University College of Law with honors in 1983. He is admitted to practice law in the state of Oregon. Michael is a member of the Multnomah, Washington County and Clackamas County Bar Associations.

Michael sits as a Judge pro tem for the Multnomah County Circuit Court Judicial Settlement Conference Program. He also is a fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, and is active in its Oregon Chapter, currently acting as its Treasurer. Additionally, Michael serves on the Board of Directors of the Oregon Academy of Family Law Practitioners (OAFLP) and was its 2003 board president, and has volunteered for the Legal Aid Services of Oregon’s Pro Se Assistance Project (ProSAP). Michael is a frequent speaker on family law related topics.

attorneys.name: Kevin Yolken
attorneys.practice_type: Civil Rights Lawyers in Eugene, OR
attorneys.bio:
Attorney Kevin Yolken focuses his practice on civil rights litigation. Prior to joining the firm in 2023, he represented clients in Hawai'i in high-profile police misconduct cases and civil rights claims in both federal and state court—work he now continues on behalf of Oregonians harmed by abuses of power and institutional neglect. His practice frequently involves claims against state and local governments, where he passionately fights for the rights of individuals.

Early in the Covid-19 Pandemic, Kevin was co-counsel on a class-action lawsuit in Hawai'i that secured protections for all inmates statewide at a time when institutional infections and deaths were at their peak. In partnership with the ACLU, he fought against policies that sanctioned a police officer’s use of state power to investigate and unlawfully arrest a minor over a personal dispute between the minor and the officer’s own child. He has represented clients in numerous wrongful death and excessive force cases against the police and prisons, victims of sexual assault and discrimination, parents wrongfully deprived of custody, and individuals sued for speech protected by the First Amendment.

Kevin’s diverse practice also includes negligence and medical malpractice cases. From a jury verdict against a multinational waste management company whose driver ran over and killed an unhoused person in Eugene, to obtaining numerous seven-figure settlements on behalf of clients ranging from fire victims to those harmed by negligent medical care, Kevin’s passionate approach to the practice of law generates results.

Selected to Rising Stars by Super Lawyers, Kevin is licensed to practice in federal and state courts in Oregon and Hawai'i, and in the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals.

After a promising alpine ski racing career was cut short by injury, Kevin moved to Hawai'i in 2005 and attended the University of Hawai'i at Mānoa, receiving his Bachelor’s degree in psychology. He later earned his law degree from the University of Hawai'i, William S. Richardson School of Law, where he competed in the National Environmental Law Moot Court Competition—one of the nation’s largest interschool competitions—winning awards for best oralist and best brief.

Kevin is still a dedicated skier and an avid sailor, having lived on his sailboat through law school and sailed throughout Hawai'i and in countries around the world. He and his wife Leslie are raising two young children to share in their love for the mountains, the ocean, and the outdoors.

attorneys.name: Steven M. Zipper
attorneys.practice_type: Asset Protection Planning Lawyers in Portland, OR
attorneys.bio:
Steve combines his 23 years as an estate planning attorney with a solid tax background working at two of the "Big Five" accounting firms. As Shareholder of the estate planning practice Steve manages the business and assists clients with all aspects of their estate plans including wills, trusts, life insurance planning, estate and trust administration after death (including probate), as well as estate, gift and generation-skipping transfer tax planning. Steve’s focus is on helping people plan for protecting what is important to them, both during life and upon their death.

As an estate planning attorney, Steve is a sincere advocate and planner, working with clients through the complexities of their situations. In his personal life Steve enjoys spending time with his family, bicycling around Portland and planning for his next big travel adventure!
